typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::BC_Query',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		RECORD_COUNT as long,
		FILENAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		RECORD_COUNT,
		FILENAME)) ~> FlatFileDestination
